items.title: ⚙️ Middlewares

items.description: List of middlewares that are included within the Fiber framework.

items.title: Adaptor
items.description: Converter for net/http handlers to/from Fiber request handlers.

items.title: BasicAuth
items.description: Basic auth middleware provides an HTTP basic authentication. It calls the next handler for valid credentials and 401 Unauthorized for missing or invalid credentials.

items.title: Cache
items.description: Intercept and cache responses.

items.title: Compress
items.description: Compression middleware for Fiber, it supports , and by default.

items.title: CORS
items.description: Enable cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) with various options.

items.title: CSRF
items.description: Protect from CSRF exploits.

items.title: Earlydata
items.description: Early data support for Fiber.

items.title: Encrypt Cookie
items.description: Encrypt middleware which encrypts cookie values.

items.title: EnvVar
items.description: Expose environment variables with providing an optional config.

items.title: ETag
items.description: Lets caches be more efficient and save bandwidth, as a web server does not need to resend a full response if the content has not changed.

items.title: Expvar
items.description: Serves runtime exposed variants in JSON format via its HTTP server.

items.title: Favicon
items.description: Ignore favicon from logs or serve from memory if a file path is provided.

items.title: Healthcheck
items.description: Adds health-check endpoints for readiness and liveness probes.

items.title: Helmet
items.description: Helps secure your apps by setting various HTTP headers.

items.title: Host Authorization
items.description: Validates the header against an allowlist to protect against DNS rebinding attacks.

items.title: Idempotency
items.description: Enables fault-tolerant APIs when duplicate requests occur.

items.title: Keyauth
items.description: Key auth middleware provides a key based authentication.

items.title: Limiter
items.description: Rate-limiting middleware. Use to limit repeated requests to public APIs and/or endpoints such as password reset.

items.title: Logger
items.description: HTTP request/response logger.

items.title: Paginate
items.description: Parses pagination parameters from the query string, supporting page-based, offset-based and cursor-based strategies.

items.title: Pprof
items.description: Serves runtime profiling data in the format expected by the pprof visualization tool.

items.title: Proxy
items.description: Allows you to proxy requests to a multiple servers.

items.title: Recover
items.description: Recovers from panics anywhere in the stack chain and hands control to the centralized ErrorHandler.

items.title: Redirect
items.description: Handles HTTP redirects in Fiber.

items.title: RequestID
items.description: Adds a requestid to every request.

items.title: Responsetime
items.description: Adds an header to responses.

items.title: Rewrite
items.description: Rewrites the URL path based on provided rules for backward compatibility or cleaner links.

items.title: Session
items.description: Provides session management. NOTE: This middleware uses our Storage package.

items.title: Skip
items.description: Skips a wrapped handler when a predicate is true.

items.title: SSE
items.description: Server-Sent Events transport that handles headers, event formatting, flushing, heartbeats and disconnect detection.

items.title: Static
items.description: Serves static files from a local or custom file system.

items.title: Timeout
items.description: Adds a max time for a request and forwards to ErrorHandler if it is exceeded.
